pattern.signal_summary: Repeated pre-runtime rework came from stale predecessor/successor bindings, copied allowlists, incidental source assertions, native-process semantics and duplicated exact-head/provenance mechanics.

interpretation: The high rework/catch density contains a real efficiency problem, but much of it is assurance-harness friction rather than failed end outcomes. The correct optimization is invariant-first semantic assurance and lifecycle applicability, not weaker gates.
expected_effect: Reduce avoidable assurance rework and repeated stale-successor catches while preserving or improving escape protection and invariant coverage.

success_metrics.target: directional decrease in comparable bounded cohort

success_metrics.baseline: repeated across App EPOCH-023 plus second-project successor case

success_metrics.notes: Do not buy efficiency with worse outcomes.

notes: Multi-project corroborated Candidate. Cross-project evidence exists; next missing proof is bounded before/after effectiveness without weaker assurance.
